author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Can the Surface Laptop Ultra run AI without an internet connection—even generate videos on battery? I test offline document chat in LM Studio, image generation in ComfyUI, and image-to-video generation with LTX 2.3. Then I compare the same video generation job plugged in and on battery, and explain who this laptop makes sense for.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
Disclosure: Microsoft provided this laptop for me to review, and I get to keep it.
